note: This receipt adds a synthetic DWARF line-table test and documentation. The DWARF mapping implementation is unchanged.
covered: a non-end line row spans from its address to the next row; the end-sequence row closes the prior span and is not itself a source mapping
no span bridges end-sequence boundaries, a gap whose previous row has no file, or discontiguous subprogram ranges
line spans are intersected with each subprogram range and the complete function range remains as a source-free fallback
a frame outside line coverage resolves its function without a misleading file or line
more than 262144 line rows omit that compilation unit's source spans while preserving function ranges
the 262144 emitted-span object bound stops additional source spans while retaining both function ranges
a decreasing line address is treated as a malformed table and omits spans while preserving the function
line addresses remain in object virtual-address space and are normalized with the ELF and Mach-O image base by the existing container path
limits: The synthetic fixture is DWARF v4; real ELF and Mach-O containers are covered by their existing fixtures.
No final image, public CI or external publication was exercised in this increment.
The product is not declared an acceptance candidate or closed.
